claims.claim: We also deal in all kinds of car spare parts
claims.evidence: General business claim; photos show only this single engine, no storefront or inventory shots.
No shipping documents, customs paperwork, or container/port photos in the report.
Photos show a static, disconnected engine on the ground; no start-up video or test rig visible.
Requires audio of the engine running; witness only reports static images.
No odometer, ECU readout, or hour-meter shown; engine block alone carries no mileage data.
No close-up of factory seals, torque-seal paint, or bolt marks on the valve covers/block.

risks.risk: Engine may not actually start or run smoothly
risks.proof: Video of cold start with audio, idling and revving, taken in person

risks.risk: Internal wear, knock, or compression loss
risks.proof: Compression test results or borescope video of cylinders
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown internal condition, worst case

risks.risk: Missing or non-original accessories (turbo, alternator, sensors, harness completeness)
risks.proof: Full 360° photo set showing all ancillaries and connectors intact

risks.risk: Exact Porsche model/displacement unknown, affecting compatibility and value
risks.proof: Clear photo of engine code/VIN plate or casting number
risks.if_unproven: Priced at lowest-value generic Porsche engine tier

risks.risk: Import/history claims (Tokunbo, Belgium origin) unverifiable, could be misrepresented
risks.proof: Photos of shipping invoice, customs clearance, or chassis donor documentation

risks.risk: Hidden corrosion, leaks, or prior accident damage not visible in static shots
risks.proof: Close-up photos of block, oil pan underside, and casting for cracks/welds

proof_requests: Video of engine starting and running with audible sound
Photo of engine code/VIN or casting number plate
Close-up of valve cover seals/torque marks to support 'never opened'
Documents showing import origin (Belgium) and Tokunbo status
Photos showing all accessories (turbo, alternator, wiring harness ends) for completeness
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a bare Porsche V-engine assembly, so it can be priced at worst case (unverified running condition, unknown model, unproven mileage/origin) pending the listed proofs.
